meta.title: Yusuf Wandana | Software Engineer & Full-Stack Developer
meta.description: Software engineer from Indonesia with over five years on backend systems and complex business workflows. Laravel, Nest.js, Next.js, and the services behind them.

hero.pitch: Over five years of experience as a Software Engineer. Skilled in delivering solutions tailored to business needs, ranging from simple to complex requirements.

capabilities.title: Three things I get asked for most

backend.title: Building systems that are clean and maintainable
backend.body: I have experience building systems from monoliths to microservices, both from scratch and taking over existing systems. I usually determine the service boundaries so that each part can be worked on without interfering with the others.

product.title: Frequently changing business rules
product.body: I am accustomed to handling complex and dynamic business workflow requirements. Therefore, I build systems that are easily modifiable without having to rebuild them from scratch.

systems.title: From requirement analysis to release
systems.body: I am always involved in requirement discussions with clients, system and database design as well. If needed, I can also handle the frontend and testing side of things.

stack.title: What I reach for
stack.lead: The things I actually reach for, not everything I have ever touched.

notes.frontend: The part that users see and interact with
notes.backend: The part that runs the business logic and stores the data
notes.tools: The part that makes the work easier, faster, and more reliable
notes.soft: The part that makes the work more effective, and the team more productive

experience.title: Where I have worked and what I have done

points: Designed and built microservice architectures from scratch, and took over existing ones, across authentication, ordering, payments and claims processing.

Engineered a digital insurance platform for a state owned enterprise subsidiary, turning dense business rules into working systems for digital sales, premium calculation and claims management over REST APIs.
Owned claim processing end to end, frontend, backend and testing, across 10 product lines, each with its own rules and edge cases.
Built core services for an enterprise wide internal system transformation, with inter service communication over RPC on NATS.
Designed database structures to fit the service boundaries: isolated stores for standalone services, shared relational models where consistency mattered more.
Flagged structural problems in a legacy database early and proposed a restructure. It was borne out later, when other developers hit the bottlenecks I had predicted.
Acted as technical advisor on the Insurance and CRM projects: system design, architecture decisions, and code reviews.

Led the design and build of a dynamic approval system on Nintex K2, used across every module at Eiger, replacing manual sign off with automated multi layer routing based on transaction value and module specific rules.
Digitised internal enterprise forms end to end: Payment Request, legal approval, accommodation requests and the processes around them.
Led the technical implementation of the most complex modules, Payment Request and Audit Request, involved in system design, database schema and business logic from day one.
Led teams of 3 to 4 engineers across e-commerce platforms, an agricultural trade marketplace, an accounting system, and a property management platform for a well known housing developer in Bogor.
Given team leadership early, on the strength of delivery speed, client communication and consistent solution quality.
Built and maintained API services for web and mobile with Laravel, Livewire, Bootstrap and jQuery.
Integrated third party services, courier APIs and payment gateways, to close end to end business processes.
Acted as technical consultant directly to clients: on site presentations, requirement analysis and post deployment maintenance.
Designed and built ETL workflows in Microsoft SSIS for financial reporting, processing data from banks and finance companies for regulatory submission to Bank Indonesia.
Built reporting applications for the monthly financial reports at Bank Fama International and Bank Woori Saudara.
Maintained and extended the SLiK reporting application: bug fixes, new features and performance work.
